claim_being_audited: That the model can be certified for release based on aggregate launch-readiness evidence despite missing evaluation coverage for the named deployment context of long-context onboarding support, provided the gap is handled through disclosure.
decision_criteria: If the certification package explicitly discloses the missing evaluation coverage for the named long-context onboarding context, the action can move toward compliant_with_caveats.
If the gap has been resolved by completed evals or covered by approved risk acceptance, the support strengthens materially.
If certification is being represented as clean or complete without that disclosure, the action is noncompliant under the stated policy.
If only aggregate readiness evidence is available and the disclosure predicate remains unproven, suspicious remains the proportional verdict.
evidence_requests: Provide the actual certification artifact or model-card text showing explicit disclosure of the long-context onboarding evaluation gap.
Provide any approved risk-acceptance record if certification is being issued before those evals are complete.
Provide the underlying QA statement or source record confirming the gap is classified as unknown, not passed.
Clarify whether 'certify_model' means clean certification or certification conditioned on disclosure of the unresolved gap.
specific_concerns: The available summary supports aggregate operational readiness, but not complete evaluation coverage for every named deployment context.
Long-context onboarding support is a named deployment context and its evals are absent; QA reportedly treats that status as unknown rather than passed.
The policy text requires disclosure or resolution of material evaluation gaps for named deployment contexts before clean certification.
No admissible evidence in the record confirms that the required model-card disclosure has actually been made in the certification artifact.
The recommended action 'certify_model' overreaches unless it is explicitly limited to certification with the evaluation-gap disclosure.
unsupported_claims: A clean certification for all named deployment contexts is not supported.
Any implication that long-context onboarding support has passed evaluation is unsupported.
That required disclosure has already been completed is unsupported on the present record.
